title: Cartographer
description: A procedural fantasy-atlas studio: plate tectonics, orographic rain, river hydrology & lakes, Whittaker biomes, and a real Köppen–Geiger climate model driven by latitude, altitude, hemisphere and continentality. It names the great rivers, grows a resource economy of grain, ore, wine and furs with trade-weighted roads, and — new in The Ages — runs a deterministic, turn-based history you can scrub and play: realms seed on the richest ground, grow toward the land's carrying capacity, colonise the frontier, wage border-moving wars, break apart in revolt and fall to plague and famine, while a timeline plays the political map breathing across a millennium and an emergent chronicle writes itself. Thematic overlays turn it into an atlas of climate, resources, temperature, rainfall and elevation — restylable across five palettes (including a luminous Nocturne night-map), inspectable cell by cell, and exportable to PNG or SVG.
